mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_session (id, principal_type, principal_id, token_hash, expires_at, last_seen_at) VALUES (#{id}, 'user', #{userId}, #{tokenHash.bytes,jdbcType=BINARY}, #{expiresAt}, #{lastSeenAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET last_login_at = #{lastLoginAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.principal_id AS user_id, s.expires_at, s.revoked_at, u.status FROM auth_session s JOIN app_user u ON u.id = s.principal_id WHERE s.principal_type = 'user' AND s.token_hash = #{tokenHash.bytes,jdbcType=BINARY}
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_session SET revoked_at = #{revokedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE principal_type = 'user' AND principal_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE auth_session SET last_seen_at = #{lastSeenAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE auth_session SET revoked_at = #{revokedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
